== English Virtual Original comparison ==
Deploy rises from 3 to 4. Later removes the mentoring +1 training destiny and makes the three-Force retrieval at Jedi Test completion directive rather than optional. It limits the ignored Objective text to what prevents retrieval. The later stick pull no longer states once per turn or here; Save You It Can prohibition, Force-sensitive attributes and Secret Plans exception remain.
